comment: Non-secret runtime config for the telegram-pi daemon. Copy to config.json and edit. The bot token is NEVER stored here — use the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var.
notes: The heartbeats use a 'ts' field (epochMs). The extension writes 'ts'. The daemon reads hb.ts, with hb.at fallback for legacy heartbeat files.
piBinary: path to the Pi binary. null/omitted = auto-detect (APPDATA/npm/pi.cmd, APPDATA/npm/pi, else 'pi' fallback).
Never put the bot token in this file.
The daemon never reads a token from config. Token must be TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var or secret.token (0600) file.
Daemon start: node daemon.mjs (detached). Daemon stop: reads daemon-state.json daemonPid, uses SIGTERM only on that pid.
